items.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: and in return the guy sent me literally a diary of the time that I was with Benny, when Charlie was with the band.

ctx.x: That’s good. Those moments in your life when you were next to Lester Young and those kinds of things are really priceless.

You don’t realize it at the time that you’re sitting next to history. You know you don’t know that. You just know that this is something else. I wouldn’t think about that. I wish I’d taken more pictures, or written more documentation. But you know an amazing thing, Monk, I get letters from people all over the country, all over the world, that send me material about where I was and when I was. You know it’s incredible. Peter Broadbent from England is doing a thing on Charlie Christian, the guitar player, and so…
Yeah, I’m glad those kind of people are around, that take such an interest.
